question: Within a radius of 120 kilometers, where can I locate fast food restaurant on the journey from Miami Beach Urban Studios (FIU MBUS), Miami Beach, FL to Butterfly World, Coconut Creek, FL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE ( amenity = 'fast_food' OR cuisine = 'fast_food' ) AND ST_Intersects( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Miami Beach Urban Studios%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Miami Beach%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Butterfly World%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Coconut Creek%' LIMIT 1 ) ) :: geography, 120000 ) ) :: geography );
